title: Elux Legend Red Berry Ice Nic Salt E-Liquid 10ml
description: Elux Legend Red Berry Ice Nic Salt features a vivid medley of ripe red berries packed with juicy sweetness, finished with a chilling icy blast. Fruity, vibrant, and refreshingly cool, this profile provides a striking fruit taste that leaves a crisp, frosty finish every time. Crafted with double-concentrated flavouring, the Elux Legend Nic Salt range is designed to offer a punchier, more intense taste experience that echoes the most recognisable Elux profiles. With a balanced 50% VG and 50% PG ratio, alongside a smooth nicotine salt formulation, Red Berry Ice is ideal for use with MTL (mouth-to-lung) pod kits and starter devices. It provides a well-rounded combination of flavour, vapour, and a tactile yet comfortable throat hit. Available in 10mg and 20mg strengths.
